# Emotion Ball eye data

This folder is the non-commercial eye-ring data from groki-bot. It is **not linked into the firmware**. The default face is the MIT eye model in `firmware/components/jarvis_eye/`.

A build that compiles these headers is non-commercial only. Keep `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` with any copy. `aora_face.hpp` still depends on groki-bot avatar headers that are not part of this tree, so it will not compile here on its own.
